# Unlimited v0.2 — protocol examples

Generated by `make docs` from the library code (`tools/doc_examples.cpp`); do not edit by hand. Every number below is computed by the library functions named with it; sections refer to `spec.md`.

## 1. Presets

`EncoderConfig::from_preset(preset, 8000)`. Raw = k / T; net = N k / ((N + 1) T) (spec 1.4). The band runs from the farthest data or header tone to f_ref (spec 1.3).

| Preset | T | k | M | N | Spacing | Grid | f_ref | Band | Span | Bytes/frame | Raw bit/s | Net bit/s | Tune / sync / lead-in |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fm_fast` | 6 ms | 3 | 8 | 8 | standard 8/(7T) | below | 2650 Hz | 483.3–2650.0 Hz | 2166.7 Hz | 3 | 500.00 | 444.4 | 250 ms / 8 / 300 ms |
| `fm` | 8 ms | 3 | 8 | 8 | standard 8/(7T) | below | 2650 Hz | 1025.0–2650.0 Hz | 1625.0 Hz | 3 | 375.00 | 333.3 | 250 ms / 8 / 300 ms |
| `hf_fast` | 16 ms | 4 | 16 | 8 | standard 8/(7T) | below | 2192 Hz | 808.1–2192.0 Hz | 1383.9 Hz | 4 | 250.00 | 222.2 | 250 ms / 8 / 0 ms |
| `hf` | 32 ms | 5 | 32 | 8 | standard 8/(7T) | below | 2132 Hz | 868.6–2132.0 Hz | 1263.4 Hz | 5 | 156.25 | 138.9 | 250 ms / 8 / 0 ms |
| `hf_robust` | 64 ms | 6 | 64 | 8 | standard 8/(7T) | below | 2102 Hz | 898.9–2102.0 Hz | 1203.1 Hz | 6 | 93.75 | 83.3 | 500 ms / 16 / 0 ms |
| `hf_weak` | 128 ms | 7 | 128 | 8 | standard 8/(7T) | below | 2087 Hz | 914.0–2087.0 Hz | 1173.0 Hz | 7 | 54.69 | 48.6 | 1500 ms / 16 / 0 ms |

The `fm` and `fm_fast` presets are FM-only (spec G1): f_ref 2650 Hz sits on the upper edge of an SSB passband.

### Decoder profiles

`DecoderConfig::for_profile(profile)`: the receiver chooses only the T range it accepts; the mode comes from the header.

| Profile | `min_slot_ms` (= block size, samples) | Accepted T | f_ref search | Impulse blanker |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ssb` | 16 | 16–128 ms | 300–2700 Hz | on |
| `am` | 8 | 8–64 ms | 300–2700 Hz | on |
| `fm` | 4 | 4–32 ms | 1000–2700 Hz | on |

## 2. Mode header (spec 2.2)

`header_word(k, N, T, spacing)` = a | b << 3 | spacing << 6 | N code << 7 with a = k − 1, b = T_ms mod 8, N code 0/1/2 = N 8/16/32. `header_symbol(word, j)` gives the tone h_j of header slot j (RS(8,3) + x³ coset over GF(8)); `header_fields(word)` inverts the word (checked for every row). Header tone h sits at f_ref ∓ (5 + 8h/7)/T in every mode (grid below: −).

| Preset | Mode | Word | a | b | Spacing bit | N code | Tones h_0..h_7 | Tone frequencies (Hz) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fm_fast` | T6 k3 N8 std | `0x032` | 2 | 6 | 0 | 0 | 2 5 6 2 7 7 4 7 | 1435.7 864.3 673.8 1435.7 483.3 483.3 1054.8 483.3 |
| `fm` | T8 k3 N8 std | `0x002` | 2 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 2 3 1 7 6 5 0 4 | 1739.3 1596.4 1882.1 1025.0 1167.9 1310.7 2025.0 1453.6 |
| `hf_fast` | T16 k4 N8 std | `0x003` | 3 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 3 2 0 6 7 4 1 5 | 1665.2 1736.6 1879.5 1450.9 1379.5 1593.8 1808.1 1522.4 |
| `hf` | T32 k5 N8 std | `0x004` | 4 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 4 5 7 1 0 3 6 2 | 1832.9 1797.2 1725.8 1940.0 1975.8 1868.6 1761.5 1904.3 |
| `hf_robust` | T64 k6 N8 std | `0x005` | 5 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 5 4 6 0 1 2 7 3 | 1934.6 1952.4 1916.7 2023.9 2006.0 1988.2 1898.9 1970.3 |
| `hf_weak` | T128 k7 N8 std | `0x006` | 6 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 6 7 5 3 2 1 4 0 | 1994.4 1985.4 2003.3 2021.2 2030.1 2039.0 2012.2 2047.9 |

## 3. Mapping vector (spec 1.5)

k = 5 (M = 32 tones), N = 8, r = (M/8) | 1 = 5. Bytes `48 69 21 00 FF` → bit string (MSB first), cut into k-bit symbols:

```
01001 00001 10100 10010 00010 00000 00111 11111
```

n_i = (gray⁻¹(s_i) + (i − 1)·r) mod M = `peak_tone(s_i, i − 1, k)`; the receiver inverts it with `peak_symbol(n_i, i − 1, k)` = gray((n_i − (i − 1)·r) mod M). Frequencies for the hf preset (f_ref 2132 Hz, T 32 ms, grid below).

| Slot i | Bits | s_i | gray⁻¹(s_i) | (i − 1)·r mod M | Tone n_i | peak_symbol(n_i) | Frequency (hf) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `01001` | 9 | 14 | 0 | **14** | 9 | 1475.8 Hz |
| 2 | `00001` | 1 | 1 | 5 | **6** | 1 | 1761.5 Hz |
| 3 | `10100` | 20 | 24 | 10 | **2** | 20 | 1904.3 Hz |
| 4 | `10010` | 18 | 28 | 15 | **11** | 18 | 1582.9 Hz |
| 5 | `00010` | 2 | 3 | 20 | **23** | 2 | 1154.3 Hz |
| 6 | `00000` | 0 | 0 | 25 | **25** | 0 | 1082.9 Hz |
| 7 | `00111` | 7 | 5 | 30 | **3** | 7 | 1868.6 Hz |
| 8 | `11111` | 31 | 21 | 3 | **24** | 31 | 1118.6 Hz |

Symbols 9, 1, 20, 18, 2, 0, 7, 31; **tones 14, 6, 2, 11, 23, 25, 3, 24**.

## 4. Worked example: "CQ DE PY2" with the hf preset and packet framing

### 4.1 Packet (`packet_build`, spec 2.6)

| Field | Bytes |
|---|---|
| sync | `2D D4` |
| LEN (16-bit, big-endian) | `00 09` = 9 |
| payload "CQ DE PY2" | `43 51 20 44 45 20 50 59 32` |
| CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE over LEN + payload | `F4 E5` |

Packet: 15 bytes `2D D4 00 09 43 51 20 44 45 20 50 59 32 F4 E5`.

### 4.2 Frames

hf: T 32 ms, k 5, N 8 → B = N·k/8 = 5 bytes per frame. 15 bytes = 3 full frames, no short final frame.

| Frame | Bytes | Text | Peaks | Bit string in k = 5 groups (last group padded with 0) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `2D D4 00 09 43` | `-...C` | 8 | `00101 10111 01010 00000 00000 00010 01010 00011` |
| 1 | `51 20 44 45 20` | `Q DE ` | 8 | `01010 00100 10000 00100 01000 10001 01001 00000` |
| 2 | `50 59 32 F4 E5` | `PY2..` | 8 | `01010 00001 01100 10011 00101 11101 00111 00101` |

### 4.4 Duration

`Encoder::duration_samples(15)` = **14624 samples = 1.828 s** at 8000 Hz (rendered: 14624 samples).

| Segment | Slots | Samples | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| lead-in | 0 | 0 | 0 ms |
| tune | 8 | 2048 | 256 ms |
| sync | 8 | 2048 | 256 ms |
| header | 9 | 2304 | 288 ms |
| frame | 27 | 6912 | 864 ms |
| EOT | 2 | 512 | 64 ms |
| tail | – | 800 | 100 ms |

Spec 2.1: lead + (N_tune + N_sync + 9 + D + ⌈D/N⌉ + 2)·T + tail with D = ⌈8·15/5⌉ = 24 peaks in 3 frames: 0 ms + (8 + 8 + 9 + 24 + 3 + 2) × 32 ms + 100 ms = 1828 ms.
